source_title: Pick of the stats: Swansea City v Blackburn Rovers - BBC
source_excerpt:
Blackburn Rovers have transformed under Tony Mowbray and are now seeking a spot in the play-offs when they cross the border to Swansea City on Saturday (15:00 GMT).
Rovers are currently two points shy of the top eight after winning four of their past six league games (D1 L1).
Opponents Swansea though are hoping they will break out of their rut after two successive defeats to keep their spot in the automatic promotion places - and maybe even regain their place at the very top.
Swansea City have won five of their last six league games against Blackburn Rovers (L1), conceding just four goals across that time.
